name: Fall Into Insanity
detailed_description: Samual Whittaker and his friends love to explore abandoned buildings. They love to explore the mysteries and the unknown that these old buildings provide. Things take a bad turn when Samual’s friends go missing inside Rosewood Mental Hospital. Come on this journey of true horror and fear, as Samual has to look for his friends and unravel a mystery that’s been brewing for over twenty years.

short_description: You play as Samual Whittaker, a 19 year old college student who likes to get into trouble. How will he handle the situation when his friends go missing and he is the only one that can find them. Will he find them alive or will he be too late..
